Northern Ireland Secretary Bans Drumcree Parade Amid Standoff

Northern Ireland Secretary Chris Bryant announced on Friday night that he would ban the Drumcree parade. The decision followed a 13-day standoff between the Orange Order and nationalists over a contentious march planned through Portadown's Garvaghy Road.
